prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1027; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in the enclosed materials, which involved a side impact at a controlled intersection. Our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment, and we expect their full extent to be documented in the coming weeks.

Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to this office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person, concerning the accident, the injuries, or any settlement discussions.

Within fourteen days of receiving this letter, please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy at issue, along with a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits and any other applicable coverage limits, including any umbrella or excess policies.

We also request that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or event data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials until this matter is fully resolved.
